name: Christine's Care
source:
A slice-of-life yuri visual novel set in early 2000s Canada. After a painful breakup with her boyfriend, Christine moves to a big city and takes on a new role as a nurse. She is assigned to care for Hannah, a woman her own age who is paralyzed from the waist down.

Christine is immediately struck by Hannah’s complexity—intelligent, beautiful, yet deeply bitter about her condition. As the story unfolds, the two women grow closer, forging a connection that might transform both of their lives. Will Christine be the one to help Hannah find new hope, or will Hannah end up changing Christine in ways she never expected?

Meanwhile, Christine encounters an unusual couple: Marlon, a muscular Latina with a commanding presence, and Liz, a delicate, half-Asian woman in a submissive role. Their dominant/submissive relationship is unlike anything Christine has experienced, but she quickly becomes fascinated by their dynamic. One day, Marlon invites her to take control and dominate Liz, an offer that Christine unexpectedly enjoys.

Last but not least, Donna, Christine's boss, is grappling with marital troubles. Suspecting her husband of infidelity, she finds herself on shaky ground. Will Christine step in to support her, offering a helping hand—and perhaps a shoulder to lean on when she needs it most?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3317630/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部以2000年代初加拿大为背景的尤里生活片段视觉小说。与男友痛苦分手后，克里斯汀搬到了大城市，并担任了护士的新角色。她被指派照顾汉娜，一位与她同龄、腰部以下瘫痪的妇女。

克里斯汀立即被汉娜的复杂性所震惊——聪明、美丽，但对自己的病情深感痛苦。随着故事的展开，这两个女人的关系越来越亲密，这种联系可能会改变她们的生活。克里斯汀会帮助汉娜找到新的希望，还是汉娜最终会以她意想不到的方式改变克里斯汀？

与此同时，克里斯汀遇到了一对不寻常的夫妇：马龙，一个肌肉发达、威风凛凛的拉丁裔女人，和莉兹，一个柔弱的半亚裔女性，扮演着顺从的角色。他们的主导/顺从关系与克里斯汀经历过的任何关系都不一样，但她很快就对他们的动态着迷。有一天，马龙邀请她控制并支配莉兹，克里斯汀出乎意料地喜欢这一提议。

最后但并非最不重要的一点是，克里斯汀的老板唐娜正在努力解决婚姻问题。她怀疑丈夫不忠，发现自己的处境岌岌可危。克里斯汀会介入支持她，伸出援助之手——也许是她最需要时可以依靠的肩膀吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3317630/]Steam[/url]]
